title: Chapter 288: Deputy Commander Of The Knights Of Hell
content:
Chapter 288: Deputy Commander Of The Knights Of Hell

"Okay, okay, from now on we are a family." Wang Shuo patted Ye Tianba on the shoulder with a smile on his face.

"Thank you, Boss!" Ye Tianba stood up and said solemnly.

After a while, Ye Tianba looked at Wang Shuo, scratched his head, and said a little embarrassedly: "Boss, can I have one of these three-headed dogs?"

Wang Shuo put away his smile, stared at Ye Tianba, and pondered: "Tianba, how about letting you join the Hell Knights?"

"Is it okay?"

Ye Tianba's eyes lit up and he was very excited.

"My Hell Knights are still short of a deputy commander, but I have a request, which is to sign a thought steel stamp scroll."

Wang Shuo told him the thought steel stamp scroll.

Ye Tianba only thought about it for a few seconds and agreed without hesitation.

He had just experienced a failure, and now he just wanted to enjoy the battlefield, and he didn't think of betraying Wang Shuo at all.

So this thought steel stamp scroll has no binding force on him.

Just like in the eyes of a top student, completing homework is not a task at all, it is just his duty.

Wang Shuo naturally accepted this general with joy.

He immediately decided to let Da Huang select a strong three-headed dog to be Ye Tianba's mount.

After Ye Tianba rode on it, he immediately ran wildly.

Just like the first battery car he bought that year, he shuttled through the streets and alleys until he ran out of power and then went back unwillingly.

The endurance of the three-headed dog of hell, that is, it can run for a day and a night, and it will not "run out of power".

After running for an incense stick of time, Wang Shuo's subordinates were almost rested.

It's time to set off for the next place.

"Tianba, we should set off."

"Okay, boss!" Ye Tianba ran back happily.

The reason why Wang Shuo chose him as the deputy commander of his personal guards was that he had good combat power and could take on this task, and secondly, Ye Tianba was relatively simple, and he valued friendship and responsibility, and should be reliable at critical times.

Seeing his tattered armor, it must have been damaged in the battle.

Wang Shuo immediately gave him a set of gold.

At the same time, he gave him the flame gun that he had replaced.

His strength finally recovered to its peak.

In the past two days, Wang Shuo and Ayub and others were separated by several miles and acted separately. If they encountered a large-scale undead army, they would send a signal, meet together, and act together.

If it was just a small-scale undead army, they would handle it themselves. This kind of dragnet-style clearing greatly improved efficiency.

They searched and rescued many people who fled like Ye Tianba.

For these people who could go to Wana Town or Nanshan Market by themselves, Wang Shuo let them go by themselves. If they were the elderly, weak, women, and children who could not find their place by themselves, Wang Shuo could only let them follow the large army.

You know, although these people have no combat power, their living and professional abilities are also very important to Wang Shuo.

On the way back.

Wang Shuo received a message from Baili Liang.

"Lord, we were attacked by surprise."

We raised our eyebrows. There are undead wandering everywhere now. They won't attack by surprise. It seems that this matter is not simple.

Sure enough, Baili Liang continued: "The other party is from Tiancun. The village chief is Yoshida Mondo. They attacked one of our columns by surprise. All 100 city defense troops were killed."

Wang Shuo was furious when he heard the news.
